CFML Language Reference: Functions

StructDelete

Deletes a key and its value from a structure.

Category

Structure functions

Syntax

StructDelete(structure, key [, indicatenotexisting ])

Parameters

structure
The structure to change.
key
The key to remove (not case-sensitive).
indicatenotexisting
If TRUE, the function returns FALSE when the key was not there. The default is FALSE, in which case the function always returns TRUE.

Returns

TRUE (YES), or FALSE (NO) if indicatenotexisting is TRUE and the key did not exist.

Usage

Deleting a key that does not exist is not an error. StructDelete also works on scopes that behave like structures, such as Session and Application, which is the usual way to forget one session variable (wrap it in CFLOCK).

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Cart = StructNew()>
<CFSET Cart.Modem = 1>
<CFSET Cart.Mousepad = 2>
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Call</TH><TH>Returns</TH></TR>
<TR><TD>StructDelete(Cart, "Mousepad")</TD><TD>#StructDelete(Cart, "Mousepad")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>StructDelete(Cart, "Mousepad", TRUE)</TD><TD>#StructDelete(Cart, "Mousepad", TRUE)#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>StructDelete(Cart, "Mousepad")</TD><TD>#StructDelete(Cart, "Mousepad")#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
<P>Keys left: #StructKeyList(Cart)#</P>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

StructClear, StructInsert, StructKeyExists
